ADDED i23: toString() returns the chronology ID "Pax".
ADDED i24: getCalendarType() returns the LDML calendar type "pax".
ADDED i26: zonedDateTime(TemporalAccessor) converts a standard ZonedDateTime to a Pax ChronoZonedDateTime successfully.
ADDED i28: date() with a month value of -1093 (out of the valid range 1–13/14) throws DateTimeException.
ADDED i29: date(Era, year, month, day) with a null Era (not a PaxEra instance) throws ClassCastException.
ADDED i31: resolveDate() with an empty field map returns null because there are no fields to resolve into a complete date.
ADDED i33: dateYearDay(0, 14) creates a date in proleptic year 0, which falls in the BCE era (year 0 maps to BCE year 1 in the Pax calendar).
ADDED i34: dateYearDay(Era, yearOfEra, dayOfYear) with a non-Pax era (ThaiBuddhistEra) throws ClassCastException.
ADDED i36: eras() returns exactly two eras: BCE and CE.
ADDED i38: dateEpochDay(65) creates a date after the Unix epoch (1970-01-01 ISO), which falls in the Pax CE era.
